types.definition: Mechanically, thermally or environmentally induced loss of continuity in a made material: microcracks and crack networks, comb/wing cracks, gouge or debris, delamination, fibre breakage, damage-induced voids. Density, orientation, width and extent go in attrs. Next: a frictional-sliding, Coulomb or fracture-mechanics argument, a failure-mode classification, or a stiffness, strength or permeability loss.
types.why_not_existing: STR/defect/extended covers crystallographic line and planar defects (dislocations, stacking faults, twins) and leads to dislocation or phonon arguments; a crack band with gouge leads to friction and pressure sensitivity instead. STR/microstructure/porosity covers pore fraction and connectivity and has no place for crack orientation or gouge. OBS/morphology/appearance is the readout, not the structural claim. Without a STR home the only option is to jump from OBS straight to PRP/behavior_class (failure mode), which removes the structure stage from the spine. The type is general: thermal-shock microcracking in ceramics, matrix cracking in CMCs, particle cracking in battery cathodes, mud-cracking of coatings, fatigue damage.

mm_ops.name: track_feature_across_series (broaden)
mm_ops.definition: Add: follow one individual imaged object (single atom, particle, crack tip, domain wall, simulated ion) through a time-lapse or frame sequence and read its displacement, appearance or disappearance. Failure mode: identity (is it the same object?) and frame-interval aliasing.
mm_ops.why_not_existing: compare_across_conditions reads a difference between two states. Frame-by-frame tracking asserts the identity and path of one object, and it fails in different ways: a jump between frames can hide intermediate or sequential events. In AEM F3a-d, 1-ps frames cannot tell simultaneous jumps from sequential ones, and that gap is exactly the correlated-migration claim. The existing op is already about following one feature through a stacked series; only its spectral/diffraction restriction blocks this use.

comments: 1) Proposed only one leaf. STR/microstructure/damage is argued from one paper; the ice C-fault has no STR home, and the failure-mode classification (PRP/behavior_class) needs a structure claim upstream. 2) Poor fits kept rather than proposed. (a) Photoisomer state (trans/cis azobenzene, AdvComp c10) is typed STR/chemistry/bonding with attrs.aspect=configuration. A STR/chemistry/conformation leaf (isomer, chain conformation, helix-coil) would be justified only if another paper in r03 needs it. (b) Single-dopant position under e-beam steering (AFM s8) is typed STR/defect/point with aspect=position. site_occupancy was the alternative, but no phase-level distribution claim follows. (c) 'Manipulability' as performance (AFM s14) is typed PRF/service_capability, poor. I suggest the PRF definition say explicitly that a demonstrated fabrication or control capability counts. 3) Multimodal: register_colocated_views worked well for a non-image pairing: a sectioned-specimen photograph that places the thermistors relative to the fault, registered to the Delta-T traces (Acta F8/F9, o29). It exposed that the 'P-faults heat ~10x more' contrast mixes fault type with sensor distance, because only in F9 does a thermistor sit inside the fault. I suggest the definition name 'sensor/probe position photographs + signal traces' as a case. 4) Rule clarification: when an audit OBS node's label states the discrepancy, its image_support is 'shown' (the figure shows the discrepancy) and the conflict goes on the qualifies edge. I used that for AdvComp o30 and AEM o36. 5) Line profiles across an atomic-resolution image (AFM F2e) were coded spatial_map per the line-scan note. That is right, and the note could say 'intensity line profiles across images' explicitly. 6) Spine rule tension: AEM has a simulation chain plus Na-content and lattice-control experimental branches (3 parallel strands), which a control-experiment design inherently produces. I suggest allowing a control branch that ends in a contrasting PRP. 7) Packet defect: in Acta_Materialia__10.1016_j.actamat.2010.05.040 the F3 and F4 image paths are swapped relative to their captions. My figure ids follow the image files.
